nodes.description: Owned.owner: current owner address, set from msg.sender and used for authorization checks
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used during two-step ownership transfer
CpublicGold.symbol token ticker set in constructor

CpublicGold._totalSupply total minted supply, assigned in constructor and read by totalSupply()
mapping(address=>uint) balances: token balances updated by transfer/transferFrom/constructor
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stages ownership transfer
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner
CpublicGold() constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address, runs base Owned constructor
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits to using SafeMath
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender]
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and decrements allowance
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls external receiveApproval
fallback function payable: always reverts to reject ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: owner rescues arbitrary ERC20 tokens
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with overflow require
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): c = a - b with underflow require
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with overflow require
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): c = a / b with divide-by-zero require
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance accounting
